articles.headline: Iowa State coach Bill Fennelly suspended for contact with player
articles.description: Iowa State women's basketball coach Bill Fennelly nudged a player's head with his hand Sunday in a home victory over Illinois Chicago.

articles.headline: UCLA raises banner for first-ever NCAA women's basketball title
articles.description: UCLA celebrated its first NCAA women's basketball championship in front of nearly 9,000 fans, decorated alumni and the 10-0 Bruins football team.

articles.headline: KK Bransford and defense help No. 10 UCLA beat Princeton 55-34
